senses.gloss:
Bhūratna
or Dharmaratna by Jīmūtavāhana. See under Dharmaratna.

Bhūravi
by Veṅkaṭanātha. not extant. See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 121.

Bhūrijanma
q. by Bhaṭṭojidīkṣita in his Tithinirṇayasaṅkṣepa, Lz. 548. [Page212b]

Bhūridattajātaka
from Khuddakanikāya of Suttapiṭaka.
Pt.. (1). Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain an. Ireland, London, 1834. (2) Khuddakanikāya, Vol. III. ii. p.. 230-52, Nālanda Dng. Pāli. Ser. Patna, 1959.
-C. Aṭṭhavaṇṇaṇa or Aṭṭhakathā by Buddhaghoṣa. Fausboll 89.
Pt.. with Burmese interpretation, Rangoon, 1905-07.

Bhūripāda
perhaps confounded with Vyāḍin.
-Śrīcakraśambaravistaraprabandha. Bud. Cordier II. p. 53.

Bhūriprayoga
or Nāmaliṅgānuśāsana by Padmanābhadatta (1350-1400 A. D. of Mithilā, son of Dāmodara.
q. in Śabdārṇava, Br. Mus. 411; by Nārāyaṇāśrama (1619), Rāmanātha (1633) an. Bhaṭṭojidīkṣita. See Belvalkar, Systems of Skt. Gr. p. 111.
Bodl. Sup. 436. Dacca 3143. IO. 1048. 4500. L. 530. Oxf. p. 110. 191b. Radh. 11. SSPC. II. B. 8.

Bhūribhaṭṭa
disciple of Śravaṇabhaṭṭa an. preceptor of Mādhavabhaṭṭa of Nimbārka school. See Bhr. p. 212.
